title: Nanite plugin catalog v1
description: Signed YAML document listing Nanite plugins available for install. Served at https://plugins.nanite.hollislabs.dev/catalog.yaml with a detached Ed25519 signature at catalog.yaml.sig. Nanite verifies the signature against its embedded catalog root key before trusting any entry.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this catalog document. Consumers must refuse unknown schema versions.

catalog_version.description: Version of the catalog content itself. Monotonically increasing semver-ish string; used for rollback and staleness detection.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when this catalog was built.

plugins.description: Plugins listed in the catalog. May be empty (placeholder / bootstrap state).

id.description: Plugin ID, matches plugin.yaml `id`. Lowercase, dash-separated, no dots.

tier.description: Distribution tier. `core` = compiled-in, informational only; `default` = auto-install on first run; `available` = opt-in.

tag.description: Git tag corresponding to this version

nanite_compat.description: Semver range of nanite host versions this plugin is compatible with.

archives.description: Per-platform release archives. Omitted for type=builtin plugins.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the .tar.gz archive. Expected origin: https://archives.nanite.hollislabs.dev/...

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the archive bytes.

sig_url.description: Optional per-archive Ed25519 detached signature (for plugin-level signing in addition to catalog signing).
